description: Update linked files that changed on disk (Links panel > Update Link), or embed them (Embed Image). Acts on the targets, or every linked file with all: true. Embedding replaces each placed item with native art, so its id changes

all.description: Every linked file in the document instead of target

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: update_links
title: Update Links
